body:
"Ensuring that logs are not forever" -> "Ensuring that logs are not stored forever"

8.3 "Verify that the application logs security relevant events."  Should we expand on this?  I think that giving examples of security relevant events would be useful such as: "both successful and failed login attempts, execution of sensitive functions and input validation filter failures"

Should we add that logs should be logged using UTC to make correlation across different time zones easier?

Should we add that logs should be created in a format that is easy to consume by other applications / logging systems?

Add links to:

OWASP Security Logging Project
https://www.owasp.org/index.php/OWASP_Security_Logging_Project

Logging Cheat Sheet
https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Logging_Cheat_Sheet

Top 10-2017 A10: Insufficient Logging & Monitoring
https://www.owasp.org/index.php/Top_10-2017_A10-Insufficient_Logging%26Monitoring

OWASP AppSensor
https://www.owasp.org/index.php/OWASP_AppSensor_Project
